front: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent videogame sprite sheet. Reference images show exact armored teal athlete identity and eight camera facings. Create genuinely NEW hands-first volleyball diving anatomy, no feet-first seated slides. Exactly 16 isolated complete sprites in strict 4 columns x4 rows, ample transparent margins, no labels. Rows are facing/travel E (right), SE (lower right), S (toward viewer), SW (lower left). Columns show sequential phases: low forward launch with joined forearms reaching in travel direction; airborne horizontal forward dive with both hands and helmet ahead of torso, legs trailing behind; chest-low forward landing with forearms together palms up ahead of head and boots trailing; hands planted push-up recovery from prone. Preserve reference chunky pixelart outlines, teal helmet/cloth armor, cream stripe and pads, bronze trim, skin, brown boots. Same character and scale in every cell. Empty hands, no ball, weapons, shadows, text, floor, effects. Genuine alpha transparent background. Readable complete limbs and hands. Camera remains isometric three-quarter game camera; directions refer screen travel. Each sprite must fit its cell without touching another.
